breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained conflicting instructions, specifying both 'Explicit forward Euler' and a detailed 'Strang splitting' method. The ground truth resolved this by removing the incorrect 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction entirely. The agent failed to do this. Instead, it repeated the user's incorrect term by adding the confusing and technically inaccurate sentence: 'Use explicit forward Euler only for the splitting framework as described...'. The specified Strang splitting method is not an explicit forward Euler method. By retaining and attempting to re-contextualize the erroneous term, the agent did not align with the ground truth's approach of simply deleting the error.
